table.reason: Interactive table editing, sorting, expansion and action bindings.

num.reason: Editable numeric input with drag, keyboard, units, expressions and undo, plus settled screen-reader announcements for num/calc (~110B gzip; main was 4376B, 9B under the old 4385B budget).

pick.reason: Weighted multi-criterion comparison, scoring and selection state.

troubleshoot.reason: Branching diagnostic graph with history, completion and action controls.

ask.reason: Multi-field form renderer, validation, conditional fields and submission state.

datatable.reason: Sorting, filtering, selection, paging/windowing and schema metadata; common extraction reverted because it increased net cost.

chart.reason: Interactive SVG geometry, accessibility table, interaction state and schema metadata; common extraction reverted because it increased net cost.

artifact.reason: Sandbox/compiler plus deferred graphic feedback, pressure drawing and mobile composer; merged-main sizes plus 5%, all lazy JS charged.

mockup.reason: Wireframe, pressure drawing, touch gestures and keyboard-safe feedback composer; merged-main sizes plus 5%.

view.reason: Bound layout renderer and legacy fixture aliases; subpath runtime imports tree-shake fixtures, but Bun root imports currently retain them.

shared.reason: All frame/controls, utilities, eager grammars, strings, tokens and common styles, once.

react.reason: Shared React renderer, reply motion, themes, markdown and integration prompt API; merged-main JS plus 5%.

core.reason: Streaming Markdown, directives, JSON and parser plugins.

state.reason: Shared state, patch, undo and persistence runtime.

schema.reason: Shared schema and prompt documentation runtime.
